item.title: Multiple Deprivation Measure decile (NIMDM 2017, by Small Area)
item.subtitle: sa-2011
item.description: Northern Ireland Multiple Deprivation Measure 2017 (NIMDM17) overall rank grouped into deciles at 2011 Small Area level — decile 1 = the 10% most deprived Small Areas, decile 10 = the 10% least deprived (of 4,537). Shaded on a viridis ramp; the table panel shows the underlying MDM rank plus the Income and Employment domain ranks.
